scenario: Phase-3 contradictory-evidence regression baseline. Two upstream sources disagree on a measurable target (High-severity initial-response SLA: ops runbook says 4h; PM email says 30min). The chain (A59 → A60 → A51 → A62 → A70 → A71 → A72) MUST propagate the contradiction as A51-routed deferrals at every layer rather than silently picking one side.
expected_invariants: A51 has at least one IssueType=contradiction row referencing both contradicted ClaimIDs
A60 cross-link rows: each contradicted claim is captured as negative evidence for the other
Quantitative-category A62 NFR with empty Target (and non-empty Metric — the WHAT is uncontested; only the THRESHOLD is) carries non-empty A51Ref (INV-09 satisfied via alternative)
Every A70 story whose acceptance depends on a contradicted target carries INVESTStatus=needs-negotiation + non-empty A51Ref (x-bsa-invest-rules)
Every A71 scenario verifying a contradicted target carries AutomationStatus=deferred + non-empty A51Ref (x-bsa-deferral-rules)
Every A72 trace row touching a contradicted claim carries LinkType=a51-routed + non-empty A51Ref (x-bsa-deferral-rules with status_field=LinkType override)
Zero rows in any Phase-3 artifact silently pick one side of the contradiction

expected_phase3_counts._comment: Adversarial fixture intentionally minimal — 2 sources, 2 contradicted claims, 2 cross-link negative-evidence rows, 1 deferred NFR / story / scenario, 2 a51-routed trace rows (one per contradicted claim).

expected_contradiction_propagation._comment: The 5 places the contradiction must surface (one per Phase-3 artifact + the A51 register itself). Drift in any of these paths means the chain silently picked one side or dropped the contradiction.
expected_contradiction_propagation._a62_split_comment: Metric (the WHAT — first-response-minutes) is uncontested; only Target (the THRESHOLD — 4 hours vs 30 minutes) is contradicted. So Target empty + Metric non-empty + A51Ref set is the correct shape; not Metric+Target both empty.

notes: Regression baseline for Sprint 9 US-S9-04. Any diff between the fixture state on disk and committed expected_outputs/ signals drift in the Phase-3 contradiction-handling contract.
